name: Flink Job Run
description: Submit (and optionally wait on) a job on a self-hosted Apache Flink cluster via its real JobManager REST API -- standalone, Kubernetes, or YARN-session, as distinct from AWS's managed runtime.
author: Dagster Community

outputs.description: MaterializeResult with the job's final state in metadata

jobmanager_url.description: Base URL of the Flink JobManager REST API, e.g. 'http://flink-jobmanager:8081'.
jobmanager_url.label: JobManager URL

jar_path.label: Jar Path
jar_path.description: Local path to a jar to upload before running. Mutually exclusive with jar_id.

jar_id.label: Jar Id
jar_id.description: Id of a jar already uploaded to the cluster (the filename POST /jars/upload returned). Mutually exclusive with jar_path.

entry_class.label: Entry Class
entry_class.description: Fully qualified entry-point class. Omit to use the jar's manifest Main-Class.

program_args.label: Program Args
program_args.description: Arguments passed to the job's main method.

parallelism.label: Parallelism
parallelism.description: Job parallelism. Omit to use the cluster default.

savepoint_path.label: Savepoint Path
savepoint_path.description: Restore from this savepoint path on start.

allow_non_restored_state.label: Allow Non Restored State
allow_non_restored_state.description: Allow the job to start even if some savepoint state can't be restored.

request_headers.label: Request Headers
request_headers.description: Extra HTTP headers for every request, e.g. {'Authorization': 'Bearer ...'} if the JobManager sits behind an authenticating proxy.

timeout_seconds.label: Timeout Seconds
timeout_seconds.description: Max time to wait for the target state (ignored for fire_and_forget).

fail_on_job_failure.label: Fail On Job Failure
fail_on_job_failure.description: Raise if the job ends CANCELED/FAILED (until_finished) or never reaches RUNNING (until_running). False materializes anyway with the state in metadata.

owners.description: Asset owners — team names (team:analytics) or email addresses.
owners.label: Owners

asset_tags.description: Key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog, e.g. {"domain": "finance"}.
asset_tags.label: Asset Tags

kinds.description: Asset kinds shown in the Dagster catalog (e.g. snowflake, python). Auto-inferred from component name if empty.
kinds.label: Kinds

deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime).
deps.label: Deps

partition_start.description: ISO date string for the first partition, e.g. '2024-01-01'. Required for time-based and multi partition types.
partition_start.label: Partition Start Date

partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static or multi partitioning, e.g. 'acme_corp,globex,initech'. Required for static and multi types.
partition_values.label: Partition Values

partition_dimensions.description: Multi-axis partition spec: list of {name, type, start, values, dynamic_partition_name} dicts. Overrides flat fields when set.
partition_dimensions.label: Partition Dimensions

partition_cron_schedule.label: Partition Cron Schedule
partition_cron_schedule.description: Required when partition_type='cron'. A cron expression restricting the date axis to a custom cadence, e.g. '0 0 * * 1-5' for weekdays only.

partition_cron_fmt.label: Partition Cron Fmt
partition_cron_fmt.description: strftime format for partition keys produced by partition_type='cron'.

freshness_max_lag_minutes.description: Maximum acceptable lag in minutes before this asset is considered stale.
freshness_max_lag_minutes.label: Freshness Max Lag (minutes)

freshness_cron.description: Cron schedule for the freshness policy, e.g. '0 9 * * 1-5' (weekdays 9am).
freshness_cron.label: Freshness Cron Schedule

retry_policy_max_retries.description: Max retries on asset failure. Defines a RetryPolicy. Useful for transient network failures, rate limits, etc.
retry_policy_max_retries.label: Retry Policy Max Retries
